publications.title: PersonaTeaming: Persona-Conditioned Automated Red Teaming
publications.body: Conditions adversarial prompt mutation on personas, including a dynamic method that generates and scores candidate personas. Designed the persona-generation algorithm, implemented the workflow, and ran the evaluation: 11 conditions, 6 target LLMs. Over RainbowPlus: +46% mean attack success rate, +7% attack diversity.

publications.title: Solver-Guided Fine-Tuning for Accurate and Explainable Poker Decisions
publications.meta: 10-423/623 Generative AI, Spring 2026 · with Cassandra Shi & Harry Huang
publications.lead: Solver-guided post-training of an 8B model for accurate, explainable poker decisions.
publications.body: Llama 3 8B trained on 3,000 SFT examples and 2,534 DPO pairs from PokerBench solver labels and verifier-ranked Llama 3.3 70B explanations; rule-based verifier validated against 200 blind human judgments. LoRA SFT: solver-action match 18.0% → 56.2%, verifier score 0.426 → 0.645. DPO improved explanations at a small cost to action accuracy.
